component.name: Passepartout
component.summary: Put images on a canvas, sized for Instagram

description.p: Passepartout fits your photos onto a canvas with a frame around them. Pick a preset for current Instagram formats, such as the 3:4 profile grid (1080 × 1440), set padding, background color and output format, and export whole folders in one click.

ul.li: Presets for profile grid, feed portrait, square, landscape and story or reel
Live preview, drag and drop, folders are added recursively
JPEG, PNG and WebP output, or keep the original format
